description: A subscribe strip on the homepage, a follow block at the end of every article, and one landing page give digest readers a visible one-click way to follow the journal through its feeds.
lead: The journal finally asks readers to stay. A new strip on the homepage, a short block at the end of every article, and one landing page point at the two feeds, with no inbox and no account involved.
